summary: Tested new Agenda features: GET /api/appointments/reminders endpoint and frontend flows (next-appt modal after consultation save + Recordatorios manana widget in AgendaPage). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASSED covering structure, status exclusion, 502 GT prefix for 8-digit phones, when_word (hoy/manana), days_ahead range validation (400 for -1 and 31), superadmin 403, unauth 401. Frontend: verified reminders-open-btn, reminders-dialog empty state, and full flow of creating a new consultation which auto-opens next-appt-dialog (default date = today+6 months). Quick buttons 1 semana/1 mes/3 meses correctly recalculate the date. 'Ahora no' closes without creating. All data-testids present and functional.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Accessibility improvement - low priority.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to reminders-dialog and next-appt-dialog to remove Radix accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: URL encoding of the WhatsApp message in appointments.py L64 is manual (only encodes ' ', '!', '?'). Characters like 'á', 'é', ',', ':' etc are not encoded. Consider using urllib.parse.quote for robustness (currently 'manana' avoids accents but if company_name contains accents or commas the URL may render differently in WhatsApp Web).
Endpoint /reminders correctly excludes cancelled/completed/no_asistio and applies company_id + branch_id filtering; multi-tenant isolation is guaranteed by ObjectId(user['company_id']) filter.
Frontend AgendaPage: reminders fetched on mount with days_ahead=1; if the user leaves the page open across midnight, the count may be stale. Consider refetching when the reminders modal is opened.
ConsultationsPage: modal auto-open uses setTimeout 300ms after openDetail. Works but tightly coupled to a race. Consider chaining after openDetail() awaits.
seed_data_creation: Created TESTReminder Paciente (phone/whatsapp 55551234) + 6 appointments (today + tomorrow variants across statuses). Cleanup runs on pytest fixture teardown, but the patient record itself and any front-end triggered appts may persist (TEST_ prefix in notes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/appointments/reminders is stable. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_appointment_reminders.py can be reused for regression. Frontend uses native browser date/time inputs (type=date/time) inside the next-appt-dialog and reminders-dialog. No shadcn calendar used here (matches existing pattern in the app).
